headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying performers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit to a standout 53.6% at Coforge. Profit growth was uneven, with Infosys and Wipro seeing only low single‑digit gains or declines. AI contributions were highlighted across several firms, but specific revenue impact varied. Guidance remained cautious, with most companies keeping outlooks unchanged.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Multiple firms cited AI‑driven deals and revenue, but only HCLTech disclosed a $219 m AI revenue figure.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed stable for most, but Wipro and Infosys saw limited upside despite revenue gains.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY, the fastest in the sector.
Revenue up 15.6% YoY with strong profit expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9%.
Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit growth was only 6%.
